words.word: and thou hast filled me with wrinkles

occurrences.text: And thou hast filled me with wrinkles, which is a witness against me: and my leanness rising up in me beareth witness to my face.
words: And thou hast filled me with wrinkles

occurrences.text: Which were cut down out of time, whose foundation was overflown with a flood:
